title: Outsourcing Life: Off-loading the Rest and a Taste of Geoarbitrage
coreMove: Delete waste first, then delegate documentable work below your target hourly rate with clear outcomes, deadlines, examples, and review.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague assistant request may return a polished answer he cannot use.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use AskSunday and India to show clear instructions improving a virtual assistant handoff.

exampleSpecs.audience: an operations lead sorting routine work
exampleSpecs.stakes: A report may become paid waste instead of disappearing.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show delegation following elimination rather than replacing it.

exampleSpecs.audience: a consultant comparing low-value tasks with scarce work time
exampleSpecs.stakes: Routine work may consume hours worth more than the task itself.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the target hourly rate calculation to sort tasks below the delegation threshold.

exampleSpecs.audience: a practice manager choosing between assistant types
exampleSpecs.stakes: The cheapest helper may lack the local knowledge the task requires.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast domestic and overseas assistants by language, culture, time zone, and local knowledge.

exampleSpecs.audience: a solo operator reviewing delegated formatting
exampleSpecs.stakes: One imperfect result may tempt her to recentralize the work.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show review improving the system instead of taking the work back.

exampleSpecs.audience: a freelancer comparing where income performs best
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same income may buy different options across places.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use geoarbitrage to compare services and living expenses by place.
